english:
Micro-Missile, Rocket Launcher, or Grenade Launcher kills grant 'Force Converter'. Sprinting while Force Converter is active grants <arc Speed Booster />.

Qualifying missiles include <yellow Quicksilver Storm />'s Rocket Tracer, Nanotech Tracer Rounds, Exhaustive Research rockets, Rocket Frames, <yellow Grand Overture /> missiles, and <yellow Hazardous Propulsion />'s Exodus Rockets.

source.text:
2 Piece | Force Converter

Upon scoring a Micro-Missile, Rocket Launcher or Grenade Launcher Kill:
Grants Force Converter.

Sprinting while Force Converter is active grants Speed Booster.

Missiles:
Quicksilver Storm's Rocket Tracer, Nanotech Tracer Rounds, Exhaustive Research Rockets, Rocket Frames, Grand Overture Missiles, and Hazardous Propulsion's Exodus Rockets.
